purpose: Executable evidence backing each Tier-I addition to automatic_approval_spdx and each release distribution-scope decision.

metadata_authority.note: The SPDX identifier is declared by the distribution itself in a machine-readable field; it was not inferred from a Trove classifier string.

license_text_authority.repository_path_note: Byte-exact copy of the distributed license text, vendored so the gate can verify the recorded digest without a network or an installed environment.
license_text_authority.identified_as: Python Software Foundation License Version 2 (PSF-2.0), including the CWI/CNRI/BeOpen history sections

obligations.distribution: Unmodified redistribution requires retaining the PSF copyright notice and license text.

distribution_scope_exclusions.name: certifi
evidence: requirements/environment.lock.json records closure_groups=['group:test'] with no runtime membership
a clean virtual environment installed from the declared locked export (uv export --locked --no-dev) does not contain certifi
distribution_scope_exclusions.note: MPL-2.0 remains review-required in policy and was not added to automatic approvals. The component is not distributed by the runtime release, so distribution obligations do not attach.
